title: Managing Partner, CTO and Head of AI
description: I set technology direction and delivery priorities across Zestic AI’s client portfolio, combining hands-on engineering with reusable AI infrastructure and staged reviews. For a confidential digital-learning provider, I led pre-signature discovery and solution design, then architecture and engineering delivery. I designed governance-agent separation and specified deployment controls for technical approval, and delivered handover documentation covering rollback, cost guardrails, secrets and validation. Other work includes connected lending workflows for a confidential impact-finance lender.

title: Chief Technology Officer
description: Led AI and technology development for industrial pipeline monitoring and analytics, combining engineering models and machine learning to investigate pump efficiency and equipment anomalies. Co-authored published case studies on pump-performance analysis and orifice-plate anomaly detection.

title: AI/ML Architect
description: Led the Synthetic Data Platform from inception to enterprise capability to support data-driven innovation and reduce reliance on live data. Developed privacy-preserving machine-learning and digital-twin approaches. Contributed to AI strategy and capability roadmaps covering ethics and accountable ownership; co-analysed cyber-physical systems for the Technology Radar and advised Credit Risk on AI feasibility and limitations.

title: Head of Prototyping Engineering
description: Established and ran a prototyping engineering lab, developed distributed-infrastructure prototypes and contributed to AI and blockchain strategy. Sponsored and mentored the team member whose work resulted in a distributed-data-storage patent.

title: Solutions Architect, Accelerated Change Efficiency and DevOps
description: Shaped the enterprise DevOps blueprint, demonstrated architecture as code through a proof of concept and proposed a common business-value measure for change delivery.

title: Tech Lead
description: Led teams of 2–12 technical architects across strategic banking and regulatory-change programmes. Governed supplier designs and delivery quality, aligned architecture with enterprise strategy and challenged technical debt.

title: Director of R&D
description: Concurrent appointment with Nationwide Building Society Ltd. Established innovation processes, an R&D ecosystem, knowledge management and organisation design across Group Olvia. Deployed an AI prototype for the Group’s copper supply chain from the Democratic Republic of the Congo to China, addressing route optimisation and response to unexpected disruption.

title: Head of Architecture and Development
description: Served as the most senior technology professional, aligning business strategy with product development. Led distributed engineering and design teams and built an in-house engineering team. Owned architecture across automated receipt processing, OCR, product search, mobile APIs, backend services and cloud infrastructure. Mentored data scientists and was a named co-inventor on patent application WO2013057491.

title: Research Fellow
description: Developed wavelet-packet methods for mobile spectrum sharing and implemented the waveform on signal-generation and analysis hardware. Researched communications for in-vehicle sensor networks in an aerospace health-monitoring programme supported by a consortium led by Rolls-Royce and Boeing.

title: IT/IS Executive
description: Design, development and testing of IT and phone infrastructure, created fully automated and redundant IT infrastructure.

title: Co-founder and Editor-in-chief
description: Responsible for developing and controlling the publishing process. Management of a small team (5-8 employees) ensuring timely delivery to the printer.
